name: Paperspace
what_it_is: A cloud GPU platform to develop, train and deploy AI applications, per its homepage.
platforms: Cloud GPU machines, hosted Notebooks, Workstream cloud desktops; client platforms not stated on the homepage
pricing: Exact prices not shown on the homepage; it states low-cost GPUs with per-second billing and savings of up to 70% on compute costs.
notable: Homepage shows free GPUs for hosted Notebooks
Homepage logos include NVIDIA, Intel, Deloitte, Y Combinator, Hugging Face and fast.ai

facts.fact: Paperspace is a cloud GPU platform for developing, training and deploying AI applications, according to its homepage.
The homepage footer names the legal entity as Paperspace dba DigitalOcean.
The homepage offers low-cost GPUs with per-second billing and says users can save up to 70% on compute costs.
The homepage offers a Sign up free option and says hosted Notebooks come with free GPUs.
The homepage lists Gradient (Notebooks, Machines, Deployments), Workflows (Beta), CORE and Workstream as products.
